name: mirage
text: Done in code, tested (app suite passes), and going out with the next app release. I won't cut a release while the other session works. 1) The phone now keeps only 8 days of settled bets instead of 35 (only days GitHub already holds), so bets.json shrinks to a small file. I did not delete the file outright, because it holds your open bets. 2) The PropLine +EV-at-Novig sweep was hard-switched off on 17 Oct and is now back on in the engine. Its rows carry the engine's own view of each line, so they can be compared. They show on the +EV tab's PropLine screen once the engine restarts onto this code. Next I'll look into the lag when live betting is on (your last message), then the chat keyboard bug.
